columns.name: btc_trend_ma100_ratio
columns.formula: BTC trend_ma100_ratio (D/SMA100 - 1 on closed UTC daily bars) at the same timestamp
columns.pit: closed UTC daily bars only: day + 86400 <= t and the day before the day of t; the running day is never used; a day with any base bar is a daily bar (as mtf_1d_*); a missing day makes every window containing it NaN; no forward fill

columns.name: mkt_trend_ma100_ratio
columns.formula: I/SMA100(I) - 1 on the closed daily equal-weight index I; I_d = I_(d-1) exp(m_d), m_d the equal-weight mean of PIT member daily log returns, N>=20 by default (--min-cross-members)
columns.source: daily closes of all PIT members
columns.pit: closed UTC daily bars only (the running day is never used); the index uses member_asof <= t at the last bar of each day, N>=20 members per day by default (--min-cross-members), a day below the floor or a missing day is NaN, a window holding it is NaN; no forward fill

columns.name: btc_vol_ratio_168_2160
columns.formula: population sd of BTC one-bar log returns over 168 bars / the same over 2160 bars
columns.pit: same timestamp only; a missing benchmark row is NaN, never forward-filled

columns.name: mkt_trend_hi90_dist
columns.formula: I/max(I over the last 90 closed days) - 1 on the closed daily equal-weight index I
columns.source: daily closes of all PIT members
columns.pit: closed UTC daily bars only (the running day is never used); the index uses member_asof <= t at the last bar of each day, N>=20 members per day by default (--min-cross-members), a day below the floor or a missing day is NaN, a window holding it is NaN; no forward fill
